phase_evaluation.method: LAL T2 with 300-second residual-phase spline; exact frequency carrier

response_model.kind: forward-backward Butterworth times rectangular block average

sampling_uncertainty.method: paired nonparametric bootstrap of injection identities
sampling_uncertainty.estimator: first linear crossing on the stored amplitude grid
sampling_uncertainty.scope: Monte Carlo source-population sampling conditional on the fixed on-source noise realization and observed threshold; excludes strain calibration and repeated-background uncertainty
